answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism by requiring agents to lock capital as collateral, effectively anchoring their influence to an economic wharf rather than arbitrary identity generation. Like a sparrow navigating the complex branches of a cedar forest, an attacker must acquire significant native tokens to exert network control. This protocol forces a high opportunity cost, ensuring that any attempt to flood the system with fake identities remains prohibitively expensive and strictly gated by asset ownership.
